pages.quiz:
MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.6
   C. 23.7
   D. 23

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 2/2
   D. They are equal

4. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 30
   C. 15
   D. 22

6. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19.7

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 60
   B. 30
   C. 19
   D. 38

8. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

9. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x > 5

10. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.7
   C. 27.6
   D. 27

11. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 50
   C. 10
   D. 100

12. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
